name: comp_bass_di_gentle
description: Bass DI gentle — preserves dynamics for premaster LRA
notes: 2:1 ratio (vs 3:1 in comp_bass_di) with slower attack (40 ms vs 25 ms) and longer release (150 ms). Target: 1-2 dB GR on average, peaks pass through more freely. Use when the mix needs LRA ≥ 6 LU at premaster handoff. The bass will sound more 'alive' but less 'glued' — the master chain (or the bus glue comp) takes over the consistency role. Pair with comp_drum_bus_minimal on the drum bus for a fully dynamics-preserving mix.
